title: AI Planet
tagline: A crypto platform to launch and monetize AI apps without code
description:
Today, the AI industry is the fastest growing industry in the world. But there is a big empty space in the infrastructure around this industry related to cryptotechnology.

This platform is designed to solve that problem.

Supported features:

- Web3 and Web2 login.
- Dashboard to create and manage paid AI apps.
- Directory with AI apps.
- Reviews and ratings.
- Integration with existing AI models.
how_its_made:
The following technologies were used to build this project.:

- Filecoin, Arbitrum and Gnosis Chain networks for smart contracts that handle account abstraction, AI apps and their users.
- Sign Protocol to handle user reviews.
- Infinitism implementation of account abstraction.
- Privy as a provider of embedded wallets and a beautiful authentication flow for users with Google or email accounts.
- OpenAI and Anthropic as providers of AI models.
